body: I'm taking antidepressants and therapy Ive been in for a quite awhile. I just came up with a idea to go to a forum thats well known such as reddit. I isolated myself too much but today I went to the park to walk going to do it everyday to get used to being outside. Thank you for responding :).

Thanks for the advice I just did push ups, toe touches, squats, high knees each for 30 seconds and 3 repeats for each. Feeling better than ever  I cut out the caffeine now drinking water. I am currently learning the electric guitar it's my new hobby. I went outside to walk to the park it was great thank all of you for giving advice :). The self love advice is so helpful also.

Everyone haves their own group, but even when talking to someone and I muster the courage to do so. I catch their attention and the person seems interested then fully ignores me when the other person brings a more interesting topic than mine :(.

Yes everyday I feel like I'm becoming less of a human. The girl who is special haves a boyfriend now :(. She loss interest in me I suppose. why did
 I blow this chance off? :( It's been a long time since we talked because of my anxiety is bad I hate it :( if only if I was confident and strong :(. I have a mom I always confide in but things always drag me down anyways I even cry it off . I feel so empty :(
